Game Overview

Earth Defender is a hyper-casual title where defend Earth by maneuvering the Moon as a celestial shield against relentless alien waves. Hone your reflexes and strategy as enemy difficulty escalates, involving rapid decisions and tactical movements. With easy controls and progressive challenges, become the ultimate protector of Earth's atmosphere in this cosmic showdown.
